item.description: Only one week left to secure your exhibit table. Tables are limited and can sell out before the September 18 deadline.

item.description: The absolute last chance to apply to host an official Side Event during TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is tonight, September 11, at 11:59 p.m. PT.

item.title: Popular cloud storage provider iDrive wants to power the next generation of autonomous vehicles with a $1,500 learning platform
item.description: iDrive is offering its licenseable driver-assistance platform to car manufacturers who haven’t built their own self-driving system.

item.title: Lenovo's Googlebook 15 seems decidedly premium based on a new leak
item.description: The Lenovo Googlebook 15 will reportedly have a high-resolution, high-refresh rate display and an Intel Core Ultra 5 chip.

item.title: How to watch Shelton vs Tiafoe: US Open 2026 Men's Semi-Final Live Streams, TV Channels
item.description: All the ways to watch Shelton vs Tiafoe live streams online in the US Open 2026 men's semi-final from anywhere in the world, including FREE options.

item.title: IKEA fall trends for 2026: create an energizing home office with bright brass and matcha green storage and lighting, from $9.99
item.description: Transform your home office with energizing shades of green and gold, to add a touch of class and help you focus as the days get shorter.

item.title: The 9 Best TV Shows to Stream This Month (September 2026)
item.description: South Park, Slow Horses, Neon Genesis Evangelion, and a Lego-fied Mandalorian are just a few of the things you should be watching right now.

item.title: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI targets $2B in annual revenue
item.description: While K3's usage figures have declined slightly in recent months, OpenRouter data currently shows as many as 300 billion tokens being generated each day by K3 models on the system.

item.title: The US Government Launched 3 Previously Unreported Investigations of Polymarket Trades
item.description: The agency that oversees prediction markets has investigated Polymarket trades on Biden pardons and the Iran war—and even more potential insider trading at Google, documents obtained by WIRED show.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro vs Pixel 11 Pro: How Apple and Google's flagships stack up
item.description: Google and Apple's latest flagships feature more AI, better cameras and few reasons to switch ecosystems.

item.title: Netflix hit with major lawsuit over alleged secret tracking of families and children
item.description: Florida accuses the streaming giant of misleading subscribers about privacy while collecting detailed information about devices, locations and viewing habits. If you’re unsettled about Netflix watching your every move during your next embarrassing binge watch, you’re not alone.

item.title: Bomb Chinese data centers to prevent development of AGI, says Former Obama Admin Official — nothing says ‘competition breeds innovation’ like blowing up your rivals
item.description: The good guys want to bomb the bad guys because they can't be trusted with the tools the good guys are also developing.

item.title: Roblox is making it easier to build games with AI — and play them outside Roblox
item.description: At its annual Roblox Developer Conference (RDC), the company announced several new features, including new game-creation tools, expanded NPC capabilities, and the ability to make games available across platforms, including the web.

item.title: Fool's Theory says the biggest 'challenge' developing Songs of the Past was making sure Dandelion's story didn't 'steal the show' since The Witcher 3 is about Geralt — 'There was a very big effort put into this fine balancing of the narrative'
item.description: CD Projekt Red and Fool's Theory have said that developing The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt's third expansion, Songs of the Past, came with some narrative challenges and pressure to deliver.

item.title: Heavys H1E review: Born for One Thing
item.description: The Heavys H1E True Wireless Earbuds (largely) translate the metal-first sound of the company's H1H headphones, but glitchy software and off-kilter balancing make them hard to recommend wholesale

item.title: Roblox will soon add offline and browser-based play modes
item.description: Roblox has revealed that players will be able to play in-browser and offline in the near future.

item.title: Meta Sued Over Training Data for Its AI and Face-Recognition Systems
item.description: The proposed class action alleges Meta illegally harvested people’s Facebook and Instagram photos to train its AI image-generation models and to build its unreleased “NameTag” face recognition feature.

item.title: Central Eurasia names its 2026 Road to Battlefield winners: Cerberus, WeGlobal AI, and LOOQ
item.description: Cerberus, WeGlobal AI, and LOOQ took the top three spots at the regional final of Road to TechCrunch Startup Battlefield 2026 and will represent Central Eurasia in the Startup Battlefield 200 at TechCrunch Disrupt in San Francisco this October.
